scripts.check: pnpm format:frontend:check && pnpm -r check && pnpm check:translations
scripts.format:frontend: prettier --write apps packages .vscode package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml prettier.config.mjs
scripts.format:frontend:check: prettier --check apps packages .vscode package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml prettier.config.mjs
scripts.go:security: go -C server tool golangci-lint run --enable-only gosec ./...
scripts.go:generate: go -C server generate ./... && go -C server mod tidy
scripts.go:check: pnpm go:mod && pnpm go:format:check && pnpm go:lint && pnpm go:vet && pnpm go:test && pnpm go:security && pnpm go:vuln && pnpm go:build
scripts.verify:push: pnpm format:frontend:check && pnpm go:format:check && pnpm build && pnpm go:build
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n admin,planer,infra,server -c cyan,magenta,yellow,green "pnpm --filter @clinks/admin dev" "pnpm --filter @clinks/planer-link dev" "pnpm --filter @clinks/infra-link dev" "go -C server run ./cmd/server"
